name: Connverz for Woocommerce
author: nodesure

sections.description:
Connverz integrates WooCommerce with messaging services to streamline communication for order notifications, status updates, and abandoned cart recovery.connverz integrates WooCommerce with messaging services to streamline communication for order notifications, status updates, and abandoned cart recovery.

Third Party/External Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on the external service connverz API (https://zap.connverz.com) to provide its core functionality.

When using this plugin, the following data is transmitted to Connverz:

  1. API Requests for Templates

    • Endpoint: https://zap.connverz.com/api/get-templates
    • Purpose: To fetch the list of WhatsApp message templates available for use.
    • Data Sent: Your API key (Bearer token) for authentication.

  2. API Requests for WhatsApp Numbers

    • Endpoint: https://zap.connverz.com/api/get-whatsappNumber
    • Purpose: To retrieve your registered WhatsApp numbers associated with your Connverz account.
    • Data Sent: Your API key (Bearer token) for authentication.

  3. API Requests to Send Messages

    • Endpoint: https://zap.connverz.com/api/send/template
    • Purpose: To send WhatsApp template messages through your configured Connverz account.
    • Data Sent: Your API key (Bearer token) for authentication, and the message payload (which may include order details, template identifiers, variables, and customer phone numbers as configured in the plugin).

All communication with Connverz is handled over HTTPS, and no data is transmitted to any other third-party service.
The Connverz API is required for the plugin to function, since it provides the WhatsApp messaging capabilities.

What is the connverz API and what is it used for?

  • The connverz API is a cloud-based service that enables automated WhatsApp messaging for WooCommerce stores.
  • The plugin uses the connverz API to send WhatsApp notifications for new orders, order status changes, abandoned cart recovery, and customer support.

What data is sent and when?

  • When you configure and use this plugin, the following data may be sent to the connverz API:
    • Customer phone numbers (for sending WhatsApp messages)
    • Order details (such as order ID, order status, order amount, product names, and customer name)
    • Store name and URLs (for message templates)
  • Data is sent only when a notification is triggered (e.g., new order, order completed, order cancelled, abandoned cart, or when a customer clicks the WhatsApp support button).

Features

  • Send notifications for new orders
  • Notify customers when orders are delivered or cancelled
  • Recover abandoned carts with automated reminders
  • Add support buttons on product pages and order confirmation
  • Easy configuration of message templates
  • Full integration with WooCommerce order lifecycle

Configuration

  1. Sign up for a connverz account at https://zap.connverz.com
  2. Obtain your API access token from the connverz dashboard
  3. Enter your access token in the plugin settings
  4. Configure message templates for different notification types
  5. Set up abandoned cart recovery time intervals

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

For support and inquiries, please contact us at navneet@nodesure.in.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New
  3. Click “Upload Plugin” and select the downloaded ZIP file
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to WooCommerce > connverz-Plugin to configure settings1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  6. Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New
  7. Click “Upload Plugin” and select the downloaded ZIP file
  8. Activate the plugin

sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a subscription?

Yes, you’ll need a connverz account to use the API features. Visit zap.connverz.com for more information.

How are message templates configured?

Message templates are configured in the connverz dashboard and then selected in the plugin settings.
